item_name: Rothco Stainless Steel Portable Camping / Backpacking Stove
item_short_desc: Rothco's Stainless Steel Portable Camping Stove is the perfect solution for your outdoor cooking needs. The vented cylinder base and combustion chamber maximize airflow, allowing for an efficient burn whether you're using wood or fuel. This multi-functional stove accommodates both fuel cubes or liquid alcohol by flipping the stove base plate flat-side up, and is equally compatible with wood and kindling materials.
description: Rothco's Stainless Steel Portable Camping Stove is the perfect solution for your outdoor cooking needs. Designed for efficiency and portability, this collapsible 6-component stove is ideal for backpacking, hiking, and camping trips. The vented cylinder base and combustion chamber maximize airflow, allowing for an efficient burn whether you're using wood or fuel. This multi-functional stove accommodates both fuel cubes or liquid alcohol by flipping the stove base plate flat-side up, and is equally compatible with wood and kindling materials when flipped flat-side down. The pan and pot holder top is equipped with three sturdy rectangular support arms, perfect for a variety of cookware sizes. It includes a collapsible fire bellowing straw tool, which allows you to control the flame safely with its extended blower pipe design, ensuring your face stays protected. Compact and lightweight, this camping stove is easily transportable in its mesh carry pouch with a cinch cord closure.
